relations.subject: Eduard Prokosch
relations.evidence: From 1913 Professor of German at University of Texas, but soon felt bitterly the anti-German hatred caused by WW I and in 1919 he was fired.

relations.subject: Eduard Prokosch
relations.evidence: Still in 1919 he got a position at Bryn Mawr College, taught there until 1928.

relations.subject: Eduard Prokosch
relations.evidence: From 1929 at Yale, 1931 Sterling Professor of Germanic Languages. Died in a car accident.
